academicReview.targetComparability: The target is the generic Liberal Arts and Sciences degree, rather than a disciplinary Sustainability degree. Each provisional UCR concept implements fields and methods supported by that target. The broad option connects the four domains; the social and cultural option has denser law, politics, literature and media; the life, mind and health option has laboratory, molecular, biomedical and neuroscience sequences. These are defensible provisional directions. They do not approve a comparison based on an unresolved external cohort.
academicReview.stopping: Three provisional concepts are defensible and distinct. Business and sustainability candidates remain excluded only because the maximum of three has been reached; they have not been judged academically unsuitable.
academicReview.weight: Every non-PPD course has a specific substantive contribution to its evidenced concept. The broad option contains actual scientific, social and cultural study. Law contributes to institutions and culture without substituting for a full environmental-law course. The life and health option contains substantive biomedical and research-method sequences. Final alignment approval remains dependent on an established external curriculum.
academicReview.courseChanges: No course replacements were necessary.
